verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents recurring billing through subscriptions ("Managing subscriptions: recurring billing for SaaS") and sells subscriptions via a payment page, which covers the recurring-invoice half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows automatic payment reminders for overdue customers; configurable payment terms are a related setting, not a reminder feature. missing for 10: documented automatic payment reminders/dunning for overdue invoices, detail on configuring recurring invoice schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers

citations.quote: Sell products, services, or subscriptions online with a dedicated payment page.
